JCBy Jake Currie6:00 PM CDT on October 7, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleIf the operators of Jurassic Park were going for verisimilitude, they wouldn’t have just included flashy dinosaurs. There were plenty of tiny protomammals scurrying around at the time, as well. Now, paleontologists have unearthed a new kind of mammaliaform—and it’s a (relatively) big one.An international team of paleontologists discovered the specimen in the collections of the Paleontological Museum of Liaoning in Shenyang, China, but it originated from a fossil assemblage in Mongolia. After a thorough analysis they published their findings in Nature, naming the mammaliaform Megacauda sungei.Read more: “How Did Birds Outlive the Other Dinosaurs?”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
